verdict.rationale: The evidence pack does not document a bulk-operations capability, such as bulk create, update or delete of users and groups, or Graph request batching. Automatic SCIM provisioning and lifecycle workflows that run automatically against users are related automation features, not on-demand bulk operations across many items. The Graph user-list endpoint is only a read primitive.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
